_comment: A relieved regiment backs out of the line facing the enemy. A tired player Infantry unit (uid0) holds an engaged enemy while a fresh one (uid1) waits behind it; the player box-selects the fresh unit and right-clicks the engaged ally at tick 200 -- a RELIEF order. The reliever takes over the fight and the relieved unit peels back to its own rear. Watch uid0's heading: it stays fronted on the enemy for the whole withdrawal instead of pivoting 180 degrees and marching off, so the slot grid never sweeps through a half-turn the soldier bodies cannot follow. TIMING IS LOAD-BEARING: the right-click must land AFTER the enemy reaches the tired unit (contact is around tick 128), because a right-click on a friendly that is not yet fighting resolves to a plain ground MOVE instead of a RELIEF -- there is nothing to relieve yet.
